note: What actually happened in the Muhurat sessions our archive holds, and what followed. This is a record of the past. It contains no stock picks and no recommendation, and it should not be read as one.

cautions.sample: 4 sessions is far too few to conclude anything. Any pattern here is indistinguishable from chance.
cautions.coverage: 3 of the last 7 Muhurat dates are missing because they fell on a weekend and the bulk backfill only walked weekdays.
cautions.liquidity: The session is one hour. Volume is a fraction of a normal day and spreads are wider - a fill is not always available at the screen price.
cautions.no_picks: No stock lists, no targets, no calls. Tip lists around Diwali are a known scam channel and this project does not publish them.
cautions.symbolic: Muhurat is a symbolic session. All of the last five closed higher, which is a one-hour gesture, not a forecast.
